title: The Cultural Cost of Overwork: Evidence from Switzerland’s Röstigraben
summary: Does culture shape how burdensome overtime work feels to workers? We exploit Switzerland’s linguistic border, the Röstigraben, where French- and German-speaking workers share the same labor laws but inherit different attitudes toward work and leisure.
